persona.name: Anand Iyer
persona.summary: Anand runs Customer Success at Dhruva Cloud, a B2B data-observability SaaS serving enterprises across India, the US and the Gulf. Each customer is a separate tenant. Account knowledge is spread across Salesforce-style CRM notes, Slack, email, Zendesk, Zoom QBR transcripts and a Jira-like tracker, mostly English with Hindi support threads.
persona.situation: A flagship tenant (Acme Manufacturing) is up for a 1.2 crore INR renewal and showing churn signals, while a new tenant (Globex) is mid-onboarding. Anand must keep each customer's data strictly compartmentalised, understand Acme's renewal risk, and answer 'why is Acme at risk and what's the save plan?' without any cross-tenant leakage.

messages.body: CRM: Acme Manufacturing renewal of 1.2 crore INR due in 45 days. Health score dropped from 82 to 51 this quarter. Risk flagged: usage down 40%, and the exec sponsor (CTO) left the company last month.

QBR transcript: Acme's new VP Eng said 'we're not seeing ROI — half my team doesn't log in.' Action items: a 30-day enablement sprint, an exec business review, and a usage-based success plan tied to two pipelines.
Jira: Acme has 3 open feature gaps blocking adoption — SSO via Okta, a custom anomaly threshold per pipeline, and a Slack alert integration. Engineering committed SSO for next sprint.
Slack #cs-acme: 'The save plan hinges on shipping Okta SSO and getting the new VP Eng to sponsor. If we land both, renewal probability goes from 35% to ~70%.'
Email to Acme VP Eng: proposing a joint success plan — weekly enablement, SSO delivery date, and an exec review with our CRO. Goal: demonstrate ROI before the renewal date.
Note: update the Acme logo in the case-study deck template.
Globex onboarding: 4 of 7 milestones complete. Connected Snowflake and Kafka sources; pending PagerDuty, dbt, and the first production alert. Target time-to-value: 21 days, currently day 12.
Slack #globex: 'Globex की टीम को dbt कनेक्टर सेटअप में दिक्कत आ रही है। कल एक स्क्रीन-शेयर सेशन शेड्यूल किया है ताकि पहला production alert इसी हफ्ते चालू हो जाए।'
Email from Globex admin: 'Our security team approved the integration after the SOC 2 report review. We can proceed with the PagerDuty connection this week.'
Kickoff QBR: Globex's success metric is mean-time-to-detection under 5 minutes for pipeline failures. We mapped two flagship pipelines to track against that goal.
Health dashboard: 3 tenants in the red this month. Common signals — weekly active users down >30%, support tickets up, and no executive sponsor engaged in 60 days. Acme matches all three.
Usage telemetry (aggregated, anonymised across tenants): median logins per seat fell 12% quarter-over-quarter; the bottom decile of accounts drove most of the decline.
Slack #cs-leadership: 'Pattern across at-risk accounts: a champion leaves, usage craters, then renewal stalls. We need a champion-departure playbook that triggers an exec review automatically.'

Zendesk P1: a tenant reported false-positive anomaly alerts flooding their on-call. Root cause: a default threshold too sensitive for high-cardinality metrics. Fix: per-pipeline thresholds, shipping with the Acme SSO sprint.
Zendesk टिकट: 'डैशबोर्ड लोड होने में बहुत समय लग रहा है जब हम 90 दिनों का डेटा देखते हैं।' समाधान: क्वेरी को ऑप्टिमाइज़ किया और कैशिंग चालू की; अब लोड समय 8 सेकंड से घटकर 2 सेकंड हो गया।
Slack #support: 'The false-positive alert issue affects 3 tenants. Per-pipeline thresholds fix it for all of them — bundling into the next release.'
Top feature requests from QBRs this quarter: Okta SSO (4 tenants), per-pipeline alert thresholds (6 tenants), Slack/Teams alert routing (5 tenants), and a mobile on-call view (3 tenants).
QBR insight: enterprises consistently ask for role-based access control before rolling out beyond the data team. RBAC is the most-cited blocker to expansion.
रोहन शर्मा (एक एंड यूज़र) ने DPDP अधिनियम के तहत अपना व्यक्तिगत डेटा हटाने का अनुरोध किया है: उनका नाम, ईमेल और सपोर्ट इतिहास खाता बंद होने के बाद स्थायी रूप से मिटाया जाए।
Rohan's record: 4 support tickets, all resolved; last login 90 days ago; no open escalations. Eligible for deletion once the account is formally closed.

recall_tests.intent: Surface the renewal-risk drivers across CRM + QBR + Jira.
Cross-language recall: surface the Hindi support thread about dashboard latency.

synthesis.business_question: Why is the Acme renewal at risk, and what is the save plan?

forget.rationale: Rohan filed a DPDP deletion request; the scope DEK is destroyed so his data is unrecoverable, while other tenants are untouched.
